+	later := earlier.Add(time.Hour)
+	first, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("first", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: name, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: earlier,
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	second, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("second", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: name, ProxyName: "proxy", LastHeartbeat: later,
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(first), IsNil)
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(second), IsNil)
+
+	got, err = s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat(), Equals, later.UTC())
+
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(name, second.GetName()), IsNil)
+	got, err = s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat(), Equals, later.UTC())
+
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(name, first.GetName()), IsNil)
+	got, err = s.a.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+	c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat(), Equals, later.UTC())
+	stored, err := s.a.Presence.GetRemoteCluster(name)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(stored.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline)
+	c.Assert(stored.GetLastHeartbeat(), Equals, later.UTC())
+}
